quest.title: Collector of Anemo Sigils
quest.description: Paimon has discovered a very unique store...

talks.objective: Talk to the shop owner, Marjorie

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Welcome. Every treasure here is unique, guaranteed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Yep, there's nothing here that Paimon recognizes, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Haha, what did I tell you! These are all rare items brought back by adventurers from all corners of the world.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Is there anything that catches your eye?

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: No need! I forgot to mention, I operate on a trading basis. Goods for goods — no Mora accepted here.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: I've been trying to make something a bit special recently, and I need a lot of <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> to decorate it with.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Do you have any <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> with you?

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Haha, it seems the Anemo Archon approves of your adventures then.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: More to the point, any <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> you find you can trade in here for items in the shop.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: It's like a seal or emblem that the Anemo Archon gives to adventurers as a form of acknowledgment.

choices.text: I daren't ask about the price!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Doesn't that shop look interesting?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> appear all over Mondstadt. If you find yourself short, just keep exploring.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are they really just for decoration?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Absolutely! What could be more beautiful than a gift from the Anemo Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: It's actually more complicated than that, but it's easier for people to understand if I just say it's for decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Obviously the reason I need <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> is because they have properties that other materials cannot provide.

choices.text: Let me see it when it's finished.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Haha, of course! I guarantee you will be quite surprised at the result.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Do come again soon — and bring me lots and lots of <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> next time!

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Please also visit if you come across any weird and wonderful treasures on your adventures!

choices.text: I feel like you're making this sound more mysterious than it actually is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it's working... Paimon's curious now!

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Haha! Well it wouldn't be much of a surprise if I gave everything away, now would it?
